name: Konohana Saki
source: The protagonist's childhood friend. When the protagonist left home, she began working at the local cafe, Swallowtail. Saki has a very strong and energetic image, but secretly harbors feelings for the protagonist. She often plays the role of "tsukkomi" (voice of reason/straight man) for him as well.
